full_page.content:
1947, October
RETREAT Oct. 15th, 1947 - C.II.
Stone-wall Jackson, as professor, as well as in action on the field always began with prayer and thanked God after.
C.III. JESUS OUR LOVER - FRIEND - GENERAL WHO NEVER FORSAKES, even FOOD OF OUR POOR, UNGRATEFUL SOULS. ! BLIND LOVE !?
C.IV. VIRGIN-MOTHER, MARY IMMACULATE --
God's own Blessed Mother, He gives us as our Refuge and next to Himself, our divine Model in all things.
With all modern equipage - including experienced and up-to-date nurses and doctors - their Orphanage could never procure actual MOTHER-LOVE for mother-less children. Jesus did this for His - not leaving them orphans - in giving His own Mother M. to us from the Cross and His disciples - us - to her.
October 16, 1947.
C.I. BROTHERLY-LOVE, - FRATERNAL PEACE.
"Ecce quam bonum et quam iucundum", (Ps. 132). Behold how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity.
C.II. SPIRITUAL READING. - KEEPING UP WITH THE TIMES IN A SPIRITUAL SENSE.
It means to be posted and "up to date" in what concerns the Church morals, etc.
Holy Scriptures and most especially the New Testiment should be familiar.
C. III. GOOD EXAMPLE BEST OF SERMONS.
Every religious of good example is "a city built on a mountain that cannot be hid." Brother Dutton who took saintly Father Damien's place with the lepers was converted by example of his .... Mr. Ryan. " ... I don't steal, Captain. I'm a Catholic." Ryan's answer impressed Dutton so that at once he started to look into the only science that carries into eternity, RELIGION, - Science of our happy relationship with God and our neighbor.
C.IV. GRATEFUL APPRECIATION TO DIVINE PROVIDENCE. ? FOR EVERYTHING-
Our existence - our faith - our vocation - Our superiors - each and all our brethen, How is it possible to thank God for having given us good faithful parents - relatives - friends - the whole universe with its details beyond created intelligence ? spirit- ually and materially!
END OF RETREAT NOTES - October 12 - 16, 1947.
